$comment: Performance at 10x (Q4), gated by src/perf/*.test.tsx under `pnpm -C apps/console test`; timings are reported by `pnpm -C apps/console perf`, never gated. Fixture (src/perf/fixture.ts): 2,000 streams (roster, findings, segments, directives), 48k runs (40 tournaments x 1,200), 100k transcript lines, the simulator grid at 40 x 120. Each line holds what was measured on 2026-10-18 plus a stated margin (DOM ~8%, rounded up; RPC and draw counts exact). Raising a line needs a reason in the same change.

onair.l1.why: measured 239: the screen folds a 100k-line transcript into a fixed scene (6 chat rows), the run picker holds the first 40 of 48k

characters.l1.why: measured 495: the roster shows a window of 19 of 2,000 plus a +N tile; the rest is the portrait and foil art

brain.l1.why: measured 135 (134 + the scene's letterbox wrapper, C1 fidelity): the oscilloscope and memory are canvases, so 1,200 runs and 156k ledger rows add no nodes. P7: + 2 for the pre-flight lamp (137 measured) + 16 for the winner's motif in the letterbox bands (2 bands, 2 svgs, rings 5, pulse 1, dots 6), which render only when the hero has a band (jsdom lays out none, so pages/brain/bands.test.tsx checks the line with the bands on): 153 with ~8% margin

segments.l1.why: measured 143: ticks are capped per lifecycle column and the descoped siding is capped, at 2,000 segments

simulator.l1.why: measured 55: the 48k-run grid is one canvas; the DOM is the HUD, the doors, and (C1 fidelity) A/1's 6-node backdrop SVG plus the letterbox frame. P7: + 22 for the winner's motif in the letterbox bands (2 bands, 2 svgs, the dot field's last 3 rows = 16, the core 2), which render only when the hero has a band (pages/simulator/bands.test.tsx checks the line with the bands on): 77 with ~8% margin

reconcile.l1.why: measured 213: the triptych bars are capped (MAX_BARS) at 2,000 held and 2,000 failed

onair.l2.rundown.why: measured 292: a 500-run page of 48k, virtualised rows plus the pager

characters.l2.all.why: measured 639: 2,000 characters in a virtualised table

brain.l2.runs.why: measured 317: 2,000 of 48k runs loaded by cursor, virtualised

brain.l2.transcript.why: measured 177: a 100k-line transcript, virtualised lines plus the line detail

segments.l2.tables.why: measured 296: the compiled-in tables (SegmentId is a closed enum of four) with the portfolio virtualised

simulator.l2.runs.why: measured 343: 48k runs in a virtualised FilterTable

onair.l1.why: one page of runs for the picker (never the 48k), the newest run's transcript, the rundown pills, the tone and the plan slip; P7: the latest pre-flight once, for the transport's Pre-flight red link (the same cache entry Brain's board and lamp read)

characters.l1.why: the roster once and the selected character's detail; never one get per roster entry

brain.l1.why: the bounded read window: the newest tournament's 1,200 runs (3 pages), 12 ledger pages (WINDOW.ledgerPages), one sample transcript per lane (9); P7: the pre-flight lamp on the brand row reads preflight.run once

segments.l1.why: the tables and the rank ladder, once each

simulator.l1.why: the grid reads runs.page per tournament (40 x 120 fits one page each) and no tournament.results: each run row carries its own health

reconcile.l1.why: the newest report found by list, the report and its proposals, once each

brain.scope.why: one pass per input change, none while idle over 30 ticks (no frame loop), none for an identical refetch (the cache and the paged fold keep equal replies)

simulator.hover.why: exactly one pass per hovered-tile change, none for a move inside the same tile, none while idle

simulator.data.why: a stream_end changes three replies the grid reads (the tournaments page, then the new tournament's runs page, then the grown tile's runs page); one pass each. None for an identical refetch (the cache, the paged fold and useSameList keep equal replies). Target 1: coalesce draws into one animation frame

onair.liveEvent.why: one live event is one React commit at On Air (the live feed is an external store read once), none while idle over 30 ticks
